title: GD&T Datum Selection & Feature Control Frame

payload.prompt: When specifying a positional tolerance for a pattern of 4 mounting holes relative to a planar primary datum A, which modifier is required to enforce maximum material condition on the hole size?
options: MMC modifier (circled M) placed in the tolerance compartment following the tolerance value.
LMC modifier (circled L) placed in the primary datum compartment.
RFS condition by default without any symbol compartment modifier.
Tangential plane modifier (circled T) following the datum target.
payload.rationale: Per ASME Y14.5-2018 Section 7.3.3, the MMC symbol (circled M) placed after the geometric tolerance value allows additional positional tolerance (bonus tolerance) as the feature departs from MMC toward LMC.

title: Tolerance Stack-up Calculation for Centrifugal Pump Shaft

payload.prompt: Calculate the worst-case maximum clearance (in mm) between a shaft shoulder and housing face given: Shaft Length = 120.00 ± 0.05 mm, Housing Depth = 120.50 ± 0.08 mm, Bearing Inner Ring Thickness = 12.00 ± 0.02 mm, Retaining Ring Thickness = 1.50 ± 0.01 mm.
payload.rationale: Worst-case Max Clearance = Max Housing Depth (120.58) - Min Shaft Length (119.95) - Min Retaining Ring (1.49) - Min Bearing Ring (11.98) = 120.58 - 119.92 = 0.66 mm.

payload.prompt: Write a SQL query to calculate the daily defect count and pass rate percentage per manufacturing line for lines with at least 100 inspections.
payload.seed_sql: CREATE TABLE inspections (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, line_id INT, status TEXT, inspected_at DATE); INSERT INTO inspections (line_id, status, inspected_at) VALUES (1, 'PASS', '2026-08-01'), (1, 'FAIL', '2026-08-01');
payload.expected_sql: SELECT line_id, inspected_at, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAIL') AS defect_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PASS') / COUNT(*), 2) AS pass_rate FROM inspections GROUP BY line_id, inspected_at HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY line_id, inspected_at;
